title: The Erdős–Turán Sidon Set Conjecture (Erdős Problem 30)
statement_plain: Let h(N) be the maximum size of a Sidon set (a set with all pairwise sums a + b, a <= b, distinct) contained in {1, 2, ..., N}. Prove (or disprove) that h(N) = N^{1/2} + O_eps(N^eps) for every eps > 0 (and, in the strongest form, whether h(N) = N^{1/2} + O(1)).
